policy.active_versions: One current validator, one current cross-object ruleset, one case list, one finite acceptance plan, one consolidated result summary.
policy.historical_iterations: Earlier prototype files, review reports, and change/handoff notes were distilled into 驗證/演進與驗收總結.md and removed from the active working tree. Git history remains available but is not required for ordinary handoff.
policy.source_paths: External original source paths are not modified by this consolidation.
policy.test_results: PASS only applies to the exact test performed; static checks never substitute for execution.
policy.research_modules: Research modules reuse the current data contract, compare against the read-only P1/P2 sources, and do not bypass the active acceptance gate or imply runtime validation.
policy.research_review_records: Static critique records are indexed but do not update the normative schema, acceptance status, or UI gate; runtime claims require execution evidence.
policy.research_scope_boundary: 本清冊只管理 AI 理解可視化與框架編輯介面課題；複雜系統解構、世界模型建構、因果閉環與模擬驗證屬獨立專門研究，可按任務需要提供方法支援，不構成平行認知核心，也不自動代表已整合進主體。
policy.human_interaction_layer: 圖形認知與固定引導流程是既有 AI 認知架構的人類使用者側延伸；允許獨立的視覺語法、互動狀態機與圖形表示模型，但語意變更須經版本化映射契約回饋核心。此層不替代機器認知核心，也不強制 AI 對所有任務採單一推理流程。

capabilities: Loads comparison baseline separately from current model; both stay in page memory
Compares nodes, edges, conditions and sources by unique non-empty ID within each collection
Classifies additions, removals, semantic top-level field modifications and presentation-only top-level changes
Duplicate IDs are reported as ambiguous identity and are never auto-paired
Missing or invalid IDs are retained as unknown identity; no index-based cross-version guessing
Shows before/after values using safe text rendering and can locate current-version node or edge
Lists direct relations adjacent to changed node IDs as review candidates
scope_limits: Direct adjacency only; not a complete recursive impact-propagation calculation
Top-level presentation exclusions are x, y, layout, layout_state, viewport, zoom, collapsed, expanded, coordinates, graph_position and ui_state
No schema validation, edit/writeback, persistence, publish or core integration

duplicate ID ambiguity
missing ID unknown identity
top-level layout-only change
array order remains visible
input immutability
direct relation context includes base and current versions

impact_analysis.registry_path: 研究/AI理解可視化與框架編輯介面_研究企劃書/規格草案/relation-rules.default-v1.json
impact_analysis.loading: Fetched from same-origin repository path; no duplicate hardcoded relation-impact table in the UI. If fetch fails (including file:// use), impact propagation is not calculated and an explicit status is shown.
behavior: Derives source/target impact direction from the existing relation registry only
Uses reverse_transitive/forward_transitive only where the registry explicitly declares transitive behavior
Labels direct, advisory and transitive candidates separately
Stops propagation through duplicate or unresolvable node IDs and reports warnings
Unknown/missing rule profiles do not trigger guessed impact directions
Detects cycles through visited-state tracking and has a 5000-state safety cap
Relationship additions/deletions/semantic changes separately flag their endpoints for review without pretending the endpoints themselves semantically changed
boundaries: Impact output is a review-candidate projection, not formal validation, an approval decision or a proof that a downstream item is invalid
The registry is still a draft and explicitly not runtime validated
Browser fetching and actual interface interactions remain NOT_RUN

cases: depends_on target change propagates in reverse transitively
transitive path and depth are preserved
contains source change flags direct child
causes produces advisory candidate without recursion
conflicts_with works from either endpoint
unknown relation does not guess impact direction
duplicate node ID stops impact frontier
dependency cycle terminates without listing changed root as impacted
impact calculation does not mutate either model
changed edge endpoints remain separately flagged for review
